blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Corn farmers in Northern Cebu are set to gain wider access to post-harvest services, with a 60-ton drying facility now operating in Medellin and a ₱4-million project planned in San Remigio. Cebu Gov. Pamela Baricuatro announced the developments on Friday, October 9, as the provincial government seeks to increase corn production and ease the work involved in preparing harvests for sale and storage. Mechanical drying removes excess moisture from freshly harvested corn to reduce spoilage and preserve its quality. It also offers an alternative to sun-drying, which requires manual labor, open space, and favorable weather. READ: Sweet […]...
